import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public class Main {
    public static int averageUniversityYears(int count, List<Integer> years) {
        int sumYears = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            sumYears += years.get(i);
        }
        return sumYears / count;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        List<Integer> yearsData = new ArrayList<>(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            yearsData.add(scanner.nextInt());
        }
        System.out.println(averageUniversityYears(n, yearsData));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
